title: Man at Anvil with Runes
description: A person with short gray hair and a halo sits centered facing forward with a serious face and both hands resting on a dark anvil. The setting is inside a brick structure with arched openings showing a starry night sky while glowing ghostly shirts float around the figure with marks and paint on them and ropes hang from the anvil.
